definitionZh: 底层 CSS 属性参与设置位置元素的垂直位置 。 这种内置属性对非定位元素没有影响.
sourceDefinition: The bottom CSS property participates in setting the vertical position of a positioned element. This inset properties has no effect on non-positioned elements.
